sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is a dense, open-weight multimodal model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, distilled from Muse Spark and optimized for autonomous agents on consumer hardware. $0.30 per million input tokens, $1.10 per million output tokens. 131,072 token context window, maximum output of 131,072 tokens. Higher uptime with 5 providers.
